lime-pulse.$description: Lime Pulse — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

midnight-canvas.$description: Midnight Canvas — Page background, hero canvas, nav surface, body base — the structural floor everything else sits on

card-charcoal.$description: Card Charcoal — Elevated card surface, modal background, panel base — one step above Midnight Canvas for layered containers

card-border-ink.$description: Card Border Ink — Card perimeter borders — a barely-visible outline that defines containers without breaking the monochrome

footer-rule.$description: Footer Rule — Footer top border, structural dividers between page regions

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Card outline borders, image frame edges — medium-contrast neutral for visible-but-quiet separation

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Light-mode hairline borders, text/heading underline rules, icon strokes — appears in inverted contexts (white cards, light surfaces)

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light text on dark surfaces, inverse labels, and high-contrast captions. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary headings, body text, and icon fills on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

font-roobert.$description: Primary brand typeface across all contexts — nav, body, headings, display. The custom font's compressed, geometric construction at 110px / 0.85 line-height creates the poster-scale headlines; its 400/500/700 range covers body through display without needing a second family. The extreme compression in display weights is signature — line-height under 1.0 makes headlines overlap slightly, producing a stacked, aggressive tournament-poster feel that system sans-serifs cannot replicate.

ui-sans-serif.$description: System fallback for generic UI elements where custom font loading isn't needed — secondary links, inline labels, small helper copy. Same weight range as Roobert to ensure graceful degradation.
